body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2005') -- <Visual News> HYUNDAI IMAGEQUEST(www.hyundaiq.com) has presented its new 32-inch LCD TV ‘Vvuon’. The most outstanding feature of it is that you can separate the speaker at will; it is originally placed under the bottom of the screen, but you can also set up next to the screen or any where else. Unlike the previous HYUNDAI brand models, it contains digital tuner. It employs FIT(Fine Imaging Technology) engine to improve image quality and 14-in-3 multi-card reader. <AVING Special Report Team for ‘KES2005’ : Editor&Publisher, Jason Lee, Joshua Shim, Nikki Whang, Sheri Choi, Sophia Kwag, Annie Park, Caleb Ma, edited by Daniel Sirh>
